scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive classification with complete independently executable standard-library enumeration and cycle-cut certificate; the proof reduces full factors to bounded-length factors and proves a forced 4-mark configuration.
scientific_limitations: Only binary de Bruijn order four, ordinary linear full string attractors, all rooted unfoldings; no generalization to higher orders or circular/online variants; literature search cannot eliminate unpublished priority.
title: Complete attractor-rank profile of binary order-four de Bruijn unfoldings
